logic_summary: BSS runtime scratch seeded each run before any read. element_semantics: Each int32 element = the current animation frame counter for ring slot i (0..4). Seeded to -i for staggered ramp-up, so negative values are valid and the slot is dormant while negative; once >= 0 it indexes the frame/sprite (its low byte is reused as a small sprite-id), advances by 1 per tick, and wraps 0..4 (reset to 0 at 5). Signed semantics are load-bearing (the < 0 test gates the dormant state).
